description:
kith-jmap/src/lib.rs has public structs that are part of the JMAP session-building API but lack doc comments:

- Capabilities struct (line 133) — no doc comment
- AccountCapabilities struct (line 149) — no doc comment
- Dispatcher::new() (line 353) — no doc comment

These are all part of the public API surface used by kithd to construct the JMAP session object. The Dispatcher struct itself has a doc comment but ::new() does not.
title: kith-jmap Capabilities/AccountCapabilities structs undocumented
